articles.title: Maroof Raza, ex-Army officer, defence expert and Indo-Pak commentator, passes away after battling illness
articles.summary: Major Maroof Raza, a revered retired Indian Army officer and prominent defence analyst, has passed away. His demise signifies the end of an influential era in India's televised strategic commentary. Widely respected for his deep expertise in national security affairs, Raza's contributions provided crucial insights into defence strategies, a valuable resource for aspiring officers to understand geopolitical dynamics.

articles.title: Smart Salaam in Jerusalem: Shifting geopolitics prompts a keener approach by India in West Asia
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing the Israeli Knesset, affirmed India's unwavering support for Israel. He unequivocally condemned the murder of civilians, stating that no cause can justify such violence. Modi's strong remarks highlight India's diplomatic stance on the ongoing conflict, aligning with Israel while emphasizing the protection of human life and opposition to terrorism in the complex West Asian geopolitical landscape.

articles.title: 2G Engineering Introduces Intelligent Solid-State Relay for Extreme Subsea and High-Power DC Applications
articles.summary: 2G Engineering has launched its intelligent Solid-State Relay (iSSR), a next-generation power switching solution. Designed to offer advanced solid-state technology, the iSSR promises enhanced efficiency and precise control in various electrical systems. This innovation from Sun Prairie, WI, marks a significant step in power management, benefiting industries requiring reliable and sophisticated switching solutions.

articles.title: Show HN: A WASM to Go Translator
articles.summary: This technical process details the conversion of WebAssembly (Wasm) modules into Go source files. The output is a self-contained Go package, using only the standard library. This method allows seamless integration of Wasm functionalities into Go applications, boosting development efficiency and cross-platform compatibility. It represents an advancement in software interoperability, streamlining technical project execution.

articles.title: DC Finally Gives Its Most Underrated Green Lantern Their Due
articles.summary: The Green Lanterns, prominent DC heroes, are poised for a significant emergence, stepping up in a major way within their universe. Unlike many DC characters who share their heroic mantles, the extensive Green Lantern Corps suggests a broader narrative focus on their unique abilities and diverse roster. This development indicates a heightened importance for the iconic emerald protectors.

articles.title: Bryan Cranston Changed Malcolm In The Middle's Original Plans For Hal
articles.summary: Bryan Cranston, famed for his roles as Hal in "Malcolm in the Middle" and the intense Walter White in "Breaking Bad," is reportedly reprising his beloved character Hal. This return marks a significant moment for fans, bringing back the lighter side of Cranston's versatile acting career, which first endeared him to audiences before his dramatic turn.

articles.title: Guide: 50 Best Nintendo 3DS Games Of All Time
articles.summary: The Nintendo 3DS, a significant handheld gaming console, is set to celebrate its 15th anniversary on February 26th, 2026, marking its Japanese debut. As the inaugural device in the popular '3DS family of systems,' it pioneered stereoscopic 3D gaming without special glasses and grew substantially, leaving a notable legacy in the gaming industry. Its anniversary highlights its impact on portable entertainment.

articles.title: How Islam evolved from its beginnings to now
articles.summary: John Tolan's 'Islam: A New History from Muhammad to the Present' offers a sweeping account of the religion's evolution. It details influential figures, sectarian divisions, and its global expansion from Muhammad's time to the present. This comprehensive historical perspective provides crucial insights into a major world religion's development and global impact for SSB aspirants.
